Name: (AT) Decorative Flowers
Author: fourleafclo
Description:
[font=Verdana][size=4]I made this mod for personal use, but I thought I'd share it in case anyone else would like it.

With this mod and Alternative Textures installed, you can move flowers around like all other furniture. No need to worry about watering, crows, or seasonal changes! Grab the AT mod, pick up the paint bucket from Robin, and you're ready to start decorating with flowers.

Questions, comments, or concerns? Feel free to drop me a comment! Please also let me know if you have ideas or requests for me to make next :)[/size][/font]
